description.value: Caffè La Tana is an Italian alimentari-style cafe, restaurant, and wine bar on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, designed after the old-world neighbourhood food shops found throughout Italy. The kitchen rolls fresh pasta daily in full view of guests, pairs it with an all-Italian wine list of well-loved and lesser-known varietals, and fills a gourmet grocery corner with artisan Italian ingredients and handmade pasta tools to take home. Commercial Drive is a well-established cycling corridor through East Vancouver, making La Tana a natural stop for cyclists seeking a proper Italian meal.

raw_osm.description: Espresso and pastries for breakfast, brunch on weekends. Lunch and dinner, wine bar, fresh pasta. Gourmet food corner store.
raw_osm.name: Caffe La Tana

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM contact details (phone 604-428-5462, address 635 Commercial Drive, Vancouver BC V5L 3W3) and confirms the business is actively open ('Open seven days a week for lunch & dinner'). The website's online shop explicitly offers grocery/prepared food items 'Available to Pre-Order for Pick up', confirming takeout; the menu lists clearly vegetarian dishes (Kale Salad, Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe, Uova Verdi, etc.). No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cycling amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field is tagged 'North Vancouver' but the business is located at 635 Commercial Drive in Vancouver proper (East Vancouver, postal code V5L 3W3) — this is a community/neighbourhood mis-tag in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible restaurant and wine bar on Commercial Drive, one of Vancouver's primary cycling corridors. Confirmed open with a full menu and online shop.

Takeout.detail: Online shop offers grocery and prepared food items 'Available to Pre-Order for Pick up'; walk-in takeout not explicitly mentioned but shop pickup is confirmed

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian dishes including Kale Salad, Caesar Salad, Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe, Uova Verdi, and several pasta options; no explicit vegan or GF labelling found
